source: Recovered fixed-aligned bounding extents of all twelve saved 250-unit review grids, plus one configured bin of padding on each edge.
definition: An initial shared analysis field, not an inferred tissue boundary. Both arms use identical increasing edges.
rationale: Recorded, configurable first-pass count grid: roughly twenty bins across the observed tissue field. Chosen before any condition contrast is calculated, without optimizing a condition effect. Coordinate units remain uncalibrated; no physical resolution is claimed.
policy: Apply this same grid to every selected raw object section after centroid definition is resolved. Do not average the former per-section binned layers. Actual masks determine strict validity independently. Extend or change edges only in a newly recorded run if the supplied mask geometry requires a different field.
